# apple_merchant_id (Data Source)

Looks up a merchant ID by its App Store Connect ID or identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_merchant_id" "example" {
  identifier = "merchant.com.example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the merchant ID. Set this or `identifier`.
- `identifier` (String) Identifier, e.g. `merchant.com.example`. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Description of the merchant ID.
